title: Each Talos boot took out WSL's .exe interop entry, which is one for the whole VM, so the owner's other distros lost it

expect.note: isolate-mounts writes -1 to /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/WSLInterop*: binfmt_misc is one table for the whole WSL VM, so each Talos boot unregistered .exe interop (code ., explorer.exe) in the owner's other distros too.
